description: How to build the 3 matte-suit pixel shaders (class sm_phatspiderman) from the ORIGINAL ones in the player's own Game.exe (Spider-Man 3 PC, 2007, 10 846 998 bytes). Contains no game bytes: "copy" ranges are byte offsets inside the original shader, "insert" bytes are ours (shortened table header, new string offset, def c100, mad_sat), "values" is where the preset's 4 floats go. Made by costume_mat_make_recipe.py.

edits.why: version token (and anything before the constant table)
constant-table comment header, 11 tokens shorter (44 bytes given back)
'CTAB' and the table size
creator-string offset, now pointing at the NUL that ends the target string "ps_3_0": the creator string becomes empty
rest of the constant table (constants, types, names, target), unchanged
former creator text "Microsoft (R) HLSL Shader Compiler ...", blanked; never read by the game
declarations and constants of the original shader, unchanged
def c100, ...  (opcode and register)
Ks As Ke Ae: 4 little-endian float32, filled in from the preset
original code up to and including the game's shine-weight instruction (writes r3)
mad_sat r3.yz, r3.yyzz, c100.xxzz, c100.yyww: our shine and reflection override
rest of the original shader, unchanged
